notes: State-department entities for Bihar, Jharkhand and Odisha, sourced from each state's official portal navigation (state.bihar.gov.in, jharkhand.gov.in Department Directory, odisha.gov.in/government/department-list) cross-checked against the existing states-br-jh-od.json ministers file for portfolio->minister mapping, plus Wikipedia 'Government of Bihar' / 'Government of Odisha' pages for Chief-Minister-held portfolios. No administrative secretary (Principal Secretary / Secretary) positions are included in this run: this session's WebSearch budget was exhausted by earlier parallel research segments, state.bihar.gov.in department sub-pages return infinite HTTP redirects to curl/WebFetch (session-routed CMS, no stable page title to scrape), and Jharkhand/Odisha do not appear to publish a browsable current secretary-posting directory reachable via curl/WebFetch alone -- so no secretary name/posting could be confirmed to the quality bar (2025-2026 dated source). This needs a follow-up pass with WebSearch (for GAD/Cabinet Secretariat posting-order PDFs and press coverage of IAS transfers) rather than being guessed. Bihar: omitted 3 nav slugs (cad, csd, had) whose official department name could not be confirmed from any accessible source -- flagging as unresolved rather than inventing a name. Where a department's current minister could not be confirmed from the existing verified ministers file or from Wikipedia, headPositionId is omitted (Jharkhand: Building Construction, Energy, Forest/Environment/Climate Change, Higher & Technical Education, Industries, Information & Public Relations, IT & e-Governance, Labour/Employment/Training/Skill Development, Law, Mines & Geology, Tourism/Arts/Culture/Sports/Youth Affairs, Women/Child Development & Social Security) and confidence is set low/medium on CM-by-convention assignments (Home, GAD/GA, Vigilance, Cabinet Secretariat, Personnel, Road Construction) that follow standard Indian state-government practice but are not individually press-confirmed for the current 2025-2026 cabinet. Odisha is the most complete: all 39 identified departments map cleanly onto the CM, 2 Deputy CMs and 13 ministers already in states-br-jh-od.json with no gaps.

departmentCoverageCheck.method: Cross-checked each state's department roster against a live fetch of its Wikipedia 'Government of <State>' Council-of-Ministers table (state.bihar.gov.in and jharkhand.gov.in/Home/DeptDirectory sub-pages still redirect-loop or are JS-rendered and unscrapable by curl/WebFetch, confirming the original researcher's note; odisha.gov.in/government/department-list is also JS-rendered beyond ~29 of 39 rows so could not be independently re-confirmed in full).

bihar.note: PWD is legitimately split across Building Construction / Road Construction / Rural Works (confirmed Bihar convention); Women & Child has no standalone department and sits inside Social Welfare (confirmed against the current Wikipedia cabinet table, which has no separate Women & Child portfolio) -- not a gap.

jharkhand.note: All 33 departments match jharkhand.gov.in/Home/DeptDirectory exactly (name-for-name). headPositionId filled in for 3 of the 12 previously-unassigned departments where the current Wikipedia Council-of-Ministers table corroborated an already-present sibling assignment (Building Construction and Road Construction share the CM's portfolio; Higher & Technical Education and Tourism/Arts/Culture/Sports/Youth Affairs share minister-10's portfolio with the already-linked Urban Development & Housing).
jharkhand.unresolvedConflictFlagged: Wikipedia's current Jharkhand Council-of-Ministers table attributes Industry + Labour/Employment/Training/Skill Development to minister Sanjay Prasad Yadav and does not list School Education under any minister besides the CM's combined portfolio -- this conflicts with data/raw/states-br-jh-od.json, which records minister-2 (Sanjay Prasad Yadav) holding Revenue/Transport and minister-3 (Deepak Birua) holding School Education and Literacy. Left unresolved rather than guessed: this is a states-br-jh-od.json holder/portfolio question, not a state-depts entity question, and the two sources disagree on specifics for these two ministers. Flagging for a dedicated re-check of Jharkhand ministers' current portfolio list (e.g. via jharkhand.gov.in cabinet page or a 2026 press source) rather than trusting either source alone.

odisha.note: Spot-checked: Higher Education Department, Forest/Environment & Climate Change Department, and Odia Language Literature & Culture Department confirmed present verbatim on odisha.gov.in/en/government/department-list. Could not fetch the full department listing (page is JS-rendered / paginated beyond curl+WebFetch's reach) to independently confirm all 39, but no discrepancy found in what was checked, consistent with the original researcher's note that Odisha maps cleanly with no gaps.
